card.name: Words just before 'commencing' or starting
card.fires_on: Linking words like 'before', 'to the' or 'and' where the next word is likely to be 'commenc-' (commencing, commencement), meaning to begin something. It is strongest on 'before' ahead of 'commencing' a second treatment.

modes.label: Before commencing
modes.description: The word 'before' after a wait or recovery period, ahead of beginning the next treatment.
modes.example: Allow 2 to 4 weeks after PDT<< before>> commencing radiotherapy.

modes.label: Other lead-ins to starting
modes.description: Small words in all-caps or normal text where a word of beginning or administration is expected next.
modes.example: WITHIN 2 TO 3 WEEKS SUBSEQUENT TO<< THE>> ADMINISTRATION OF CEFOTETAN

modes.label: Partway through commence-words
modes.description: Inside a word of beginning or starting, such as bombardment.
modes.example: Bom bard<<ment>> of Fort Sumter began at 4

card.writes: It pushes the model toward writing 'comm' (as in commencing) and away from 'start' and 'art' words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a likely 'commencing' or 'starting', as in 'wait two weeks before commencing therapy'.
